reason: The README describes a dsh plugin that intercepts file and shell operations outside the workspace, requests user approval, exposes a global setting, and patches host permission handling; its primary purpose is workspace-scoped file and terminal access control.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh 提供工作区范围控制，在代理访问工作区外的文件或终端工具时请求用户确认。
summaries.en: Adds workspace-scope controls to dsh by requesting user approval when agent file or terminal tools access paths outside the workspace.

capabilities: Intercepts agent file and shell tool calls
Detects paths outside the workspace and requests per-call user approval
Modifies permission preset labeling and persists a global workspace-only setting
Patches host and related plugin files during installation or upgrades
